_note: Placeholder dart types until Paul's blaster cards exist. Units: metres, seconds. drag is the fraction of speed lost per second (v *= 1 - drag * dt). gravityScale multiplies 9.81 m/s^2. impulse is in newton-seconds and is applied to a dynamic body when a dart hits it. Darts are drawn larger than real foam darts on purpose, so they read on screen. fireInterval is the minimum seconds between shots of this type.
